def controller(path):
    queue = read(path)
    root = path.parent
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    state = {"queue": ref(path), "owner": owner, "completed": {}}
    child = child_owner = None
    try:
        for label, binding in queue["stages"].items():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            plan = read(binding["path"])
            guard(plan)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200
                save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "waiting-for-52GiB-headroom", "stage": label})
                time.sleep(2)
            assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
            work = Path(plan["work"])
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
                       CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0", HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                       OMP_NUM_THREADS="1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                       CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8")
            with (root / f"collect-{label}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), "-P", plan["collector"]["path"], binding["path"]],
                    cwd=work, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                )
                child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "running-declared-stage",
                                               "stage": label, "child": child_owner})
                assert child.wait(timeout=3600) == 0, label
            result = work.parent / "collection-v1.json"
            assert read(result)["counts"] == {"root": len(plan["observations"]), "encoder": len(plan["observations"])}
            assert not live(child_owner)
            state["completed"][label] = ref(result)
        save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "completed-1524-new-forwards-awaiting-audits",
                                       "new_root_forwards": 1524, "new_DINO_forwards": 1524})
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path))
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

        and state["config"]["initialized_from"] == plan["expected_lineage"]
        and len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == plan["EMA_tensors"] == tensors
        and state["model"].keys() == state["ema"].keys()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Progress checkpoint step, horizon, architecture or lineage differs")
    states = state["optimizer"]["state"]
    if len(states) != optimizer_states or any(float(s["step"]) != step for s in states.values()):
        raise ValueError("Progress optimizer state count or update step differs")
    values = [*state["model"].values(), *state["ema"].values()]
    values += [v for s in states.values() for v in s.values() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)]
    if any(not torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite progress model, EMA or optimizer state")
    branch = [k for k in state["model"] if k.startswith("pretrained_rgb.raw_spatial.")]
    if len(branch) != (23 if spatial else 0):
        raise ValueError("Progress spatial state coverage differs")


def collect(path):
    import torch
    from frozen_backbone_identity import verify_backbone_identity
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    if not Path(load_checkpoint.__code__.co_filename).resolve().is_relative_to(work / "src"):
        raise RuntimeError("Use the plan's frozen inference source")
    if ref(__file__) != plan["collector"] or os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "0":
        raise RuntimeError("Collector source/device differs")
    observations = plan["observations"]
    if len(observations) != plan["planned_new_root_forwards"] or len(
        {o["id"] for o in observations}
    ) != len(observations):
        raise ValueError("Declare distinct observations and an exact forward budget")
    with (root / "collect.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True

    def resources(initial=False):
        reserve = plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] if initial else plan["runtime_RAM_GiB"]
        if psutil.virtual_memory().available < reserve * 2**30:
            raise RuntimeError("Host memory reserve reached")
        for location, key in ((root, "internal"), (Path("/mnt/external"), "external")):
            reserve = plan[("launch_" if initial else "runtime_") + key + "_reserve_GiB"]
            if shutil.disk_usage(location).free < reserve * 2**30:
                raise RuntimeError("Disk reserve reached")

    resources(initial=True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        plan["CUDA_quota_GiB"] * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    python_rng, numpy_rng = random.getstate(), np.random.get_state()
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    counts = {"root": 0, "encoder": 0}
    rows = []
    witness = {}
    if plan.get("progress_checkpoint", False):
        state = torch.load(
            plan["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True
        )
        verify_progress_checkpoint(state, plan)
        del state
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[0]):
        model, state = load_checkpoint(plan["checkpoint"]["path"], "cuda")
        if (
            state["loaded_sha256"] != plan["checkpoint"]["sha256"]
            or state["step"] != plan["step"]
            or state["config"]["initialized_from"] != plan["expected_lineage"]
            or model.config.raw_frequency_features != plan.get("raw_frequency_features", True)
            or (model.pretrained_rgb.raw_frequency is not None)
            != plan.get("raw_frequency_features", True)
            or (
                "raw_spatial_features" in plan
                and getattr(model.config, "raw_spatial_features", False)
                is not plan["raw_spatial_features"]
            )
            or (
                "raw_global_features" in plan
                and getattr(model.config, "raw_global_features", False)
                is not plan["raw_global_features"]
            )
            or (
                "raw_global_conditioning" in plan
                and getattr(model.config, "raw_global_conditioning", "legacy-v1")
                != plan["raw_global_conditioning"]
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("Loaded checkpoint identity or frequency-adapter setting differs")
        if model.config.raw_frequency_features:
            if model.config.raw_frequency_window != plan["raw_frequency_window"]:
                raise ValueError("Loaded Fourier-window metadata differs")
            if model.pretrained_rgb.raw_frequency.max_window != plan["raw_frequency_window"]:
                raise ValueError("Actual Fourier module window differs")
        actual = model.restoration_state_dict()
        if len(actual) != plan["EMA_tensors"] or any(
            not torch.equal(v.cpu(), state["ema"][k]) for k, v in actual.items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Model did not load the exact preserved EMA")
        backbone_before = model_hash(model.context.backbone)
        verify_backbone_identity(
            model.config.to_dict(),
            backbone_before,
            {"expected_backbone": plan["expected_backbone"]},
            legacy_sha256=plan["expected_backbone"]["sha256"],
        )
        del actual, state
        model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        before = model_hash(model)
        if plan.get("expected_full_model_sha256", before) != before:
            raise ValueError("Loaded model differs from its retained identity")
        save(
            root / "loaded-model-v1.json",
            {
                "plan": ref(path),
                "full_model_sha256": before,
                "backbone_sha256": backbone_before,
                "new_forwards_so_far": 0,
            },
        )

        def pre_hook(module, args):
            resources()
            if (
                module.training
                or torch.is_autocast_enabled("cuda")
                or (torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 or torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32)
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("Pilot requires evaluation in IEEE FP32")
            if counts["root"] >= len(observations):
                raise RuntimeError("Prospective forward budget exhausted")
            if {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in zip(NAMES, args, strict=True)} != witness["inputs"]:
                raise ValueError("Actual forward arguments differ from retained bytes")
            counts["root"] += 1

        def encoder_hook(*args):
            counts["encoder"] += 1
            if counts["encoder"] > len(observations):
                raise RuntimeError("Encoder forward budget exhausted")

        handles = [
            model.register_forward_pre_hook(pre_hook),
            model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(encoder_hook),
        ]
        destination = work / "artifacts/predictions"
        destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        journal = root / "predictions-v1.jsonl"
        with journal.open("x") as stream, torch.inference_mode():
            for index, observation in enumerate(observations):
                with np.load(observation["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as data:
                    arrays = {k: data[k] for k in NAMES}
                witness["inputs"] = observation["input_fingerprints"]
                if {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} != witness["inputs"]:
                    raise ValueError("Stored input bytes differ")
                batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).to("cuda") for k, v in arrays.items()}
                model.set_noise(observation["noise"]["shot"], observation["noise"]["read"])
                value = model(*(batch[k] for k in NAMES))
                if (
                    value.dtype != torch.float32
                    or list(value.shape) != observation["output_shape"]
                    or not torch.isfinite(value).all()
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Invalid native FP32 prediction")
                if {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in batch.items()} != witness["inputs"]:
                    raise ValueError("Inference mutated input observations")
                prediction = value.cpu().numpy()
                output = destination / f"prediction-{index:03d}.npy"
                with output.open("xb") as handle:
                    np.save(handle, prediction, allow_pickle=False)
                row = {
                    "id": observation["id"],
                    "prediction": ref(output),
                    "values": fingerprint(prediction),
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                }
                stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                rows.append(row)
                print(json.dumps({"completed": index + 1, "id": row["id"], **counts}), flush=True)
                del value, prediction, batch
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
        after, backbone_after = model_hash(model), model_hash(model.context.backbone)
        if before != after or backbone_before != backbone_after:
            raise ValueError("Inference mutated model state")
    if (
        not torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state())
        or not torch.equal(cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state())
        or random.getstate() != python_rng
        or any(
            not np.array_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(numpy_rng, np.random.get_state(), strict=True)
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("Pilot changed RNG state")
    guard(plan)
    if counts != {"root": len(observations), "encoder": len(observations)}:
        raise ValueError("Actual forward counts differ")
    save(
        root / "collection-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-declared-checkpoint-retained-input-pilot",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "predictions": ref(journal),
            "counts": counts,
            "full_model_before": before,
            "full_model_after": after,
            "backbone_before": backbone_before,
            "backbone_after": backbone_after,
            "new_reference_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_observations": 0,
            "RAW_decodes": 0,
            "optimizer_updates": 0,
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "torch": torch.__version__,
            "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
            "progress_checkpoint_verified": plan.get("progress_checkpoint", False),
            "training_horizon": plan.get("training_horizon"),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
            "observations": rows,
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    collect(parser.parse_args().plan)

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def ref(path):
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": sha(path)}


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def guard(plan):
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert sha(item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    for path, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert sha(path) == digest, path

import argparse

def checked(item):
    if ref(item["path"]) != item:
        raise ValueError("Retained artifact changed")
    return Path(item["path"])


def band(values):
    """DCT16 annulus 1/8 <= radial frequency < 1/3, native160 pixels."""
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
    c = np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(16)[None] + 0.5) * np.arange(16)[:, None] / 16)
    c *= np.sqrt(2 / 16)
    c[0] /= np.sqrt(2)
    f = np.arange(16) / 32
    radius = np.hypot(f[:, None], f[None])
    selected = (radius >= 1 / 8) & (radius < 1 / 3)
    luma = np.einsum("c,bchw->bhw", np.array([0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722]), values)
    blocks = luma.reshape(len(luma), 10, 16, 10, 16).transpose(0, 1, 3, 2, 4)
    blocks = blocks.reshape(len(luma), 100, 16, 16)
    return (c @ blocks @ c.T)[..., selected], blocks.mean((-1, -2))


def pixels(value, arrays, roi, exposure):
    x, y, w, h = roi
    rendered = display(value.astype(np.float64), arrays, exposure)
    return np.rint(rendered[0, :, y : y + h, x : x + w].transpose(1, 2, 0) * 255).astype(np.uint8)


def statistics(prediction, target, arrays):
    prediction, target = [v[..., 48:208, 48:208].astype(np.float64) for v in (prediction, target)]
    camera_mse = float(np.mean((prediction.clip(0, 1) - target.clip(0, 1)) ** 2))
    srgb_mse = float(np.mean((display(prediction, arrays) - display(target, arrays)) ** 2))
    p, _ = band(linear_rgb(prediction, arrays))
    truth = linear_rgb(target, arrays)
    t, means = band(truth)
    valid = ((truth[0] >= 0) & (truth[0] <= 1)).all(0)
    valid = valid.reshape(10, 16, 10, 16).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(100, 256).all(1)
    rms = np.sqrt(np.sum(t[0] ** 2, axis=-1) / 256)
    valid &= (means[0] >= 0.02) & (means[0] <= 0.9) & (rms >= 1e-5)
    contrast = rms / np.maximum(means[0], 1e-12)
    bins = []
    edges = (0, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, np.inf)
    for index, (low, high) in enumerate(pairwise(edges)):
        selected = valid & (contrast >= low) & (contrast < high)
        count = int(selected.sum())
        if not count:
            continue
        a, b = p[0, selected], t[0, selected]
        gain = float(np.sum(a * b) / np.sum(b * b))
        bins.append(
            {
                "bin": index,
                "blocks": count,
                "gain": gain,
                "band_error_RMS": float(np.sqrt(np.sum((a - b) ** 2) / (count * 256))),
                "orthogonal_residual_RMS": float(
                    np.sqrt(np.sum((a - gain * b) ** 2) / (count * 256))
                ),
            }
        )
    return {
        "camera_RGB_PSNR": float(-10 * np.log10(max(camera_mse, 1e-12))),
        "sRGB_PSNR": float(-10 * np.log10(max(srgb_mse, 1e-12))),
        "bands": bins,
    }


def report(plan_path, collection_path, *, model_label=None):
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    plan, collection = read(plan_path), read(collection_path)
    guard(plan)
    expected = len(plan["observations"])
    if collection["plan"] != ref(plan_path) or collection["counts"] != {
        "root": expected,
        "encoder": expected,
    }:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected pilot collection")
    model_label = model_label or plan.get("model_label", "V123 9k EMA")
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "report.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    output = root / "report-v1"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    rows = {r["id"]: r for r in collection["observations"]}
    if set(rows) != {o["id"] for o in plan["observations"]}:
        raise ValueError("Missing or unexpected pilot observations")
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    images, metrics = [], []

    def board(name, cells, metadata):
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + len(cells) * 168, 192), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        panels = []
        for i, (label, cell) in enumerate(cells):
            if cell.shape != (160, 160, 3) or cell.dtype != np.uint8:
                raise ValueError("Publish only native160 crops without resizing")
            x, y = 8 + 168 * i, 24
            draw.text((x, 5), label, fill="black", font=font)
            canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), (x, y))
            panels.append({"label": label, "png_xywh": [x, y, 160, 160]})
        path = output / (name + ".png")
        canvas.save(path)
        # Independently reread PNG pixels: every cell must equal its source crop.
        reread = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
        for panel, (_, cell) in zip(panels, cells, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = panel["png_xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y : y + h, x : x + w], cell)
        images.append({"name": name, "image": ref(path), "panels": panels, **metadata})

    for observation in plan["observations"]:
        with np.load(checked(observation["arrays"]), allow_pickle=False) as archive:
            arrays = {k: archive[k] for k in archive.files}
        new = np.load(checked(rows[observation["id"]]["prediction"]), allow_pickle=False)
        controls = observation.get("controls", [])
        predictions = [
            (
                c.get("label", c.get("model", {}).get("label")),
                np.load(checked(c["prediction"]), allow_pickle=False),
            )
            for c in controls
        ]
        predictions.append((model_label, new))
        metadata = {
            "observation_id": observation["id"],
            "checkpoint": plan["checkpoint"],
            "step": plan["step"],
            "input_arrays": observation["arrays"],
            "noise": observation["noise"],
            "display_exposure": observation["display_exposure"],
            "reference_role": observation["reference_role"],
            "no_resize": True,
        }
        if observation["kind"] in {"material", "shadow-material"}:
            with np.load(checked(observation["target"])) as data:
                target = data["target"]
            exposure = observation["display_exposure"]
            case_id = observation["case_id"]
            if observation["kind"] == "shadow-material":
                case_id += "-" + observation["noise"]["name"]
            for label, prediction in predictions:
                metrics.append(
                    {
                        "case": case_id,
                        "method": label,
                        "pattern": observation["pattern"],
                        "draw": 0,
                        "reference_role": observation["reference_role"],
                        **statistics(
                            prediction.astype(np.float64) * exposure,
                            target.astype(np.float64) * exposure,
                            arrays,
                        ),
                    }
                )
            if observation["pattern"] != "RGGB":
                continue
            roi = observation["ROI_xywh"]
            gtlabel = (
                "GT (synthetic)"
                if observation.get("original_case_id", observation["case_id"])
                in ("bark", "raccoon-fur")
                else "Binned ref (not GT)"
            )
            noisy = pixels(noisy_malvar(arrays), arrays, roi, exposure)
            truth = pixels(target, arrays, roi, exposure)
            denoised = pixels(new, arrays, roi, exposure)
            metadata.update({"case": observation["case"], "ROI_xywh": roi})
            board(
                case_id + "-comparison",
                [("Noisy draw0", noisy)]
                + [(label, pixels(p, arrays, roi, exposure)) for label, p in predictions]
                + [(gtlabel, truth)],
                metadata,
            )
            board(
                case_id + "-triplet",
                [("Noisy draw0", noisy), (model_label, denoised), (gtlabel, truth)],
                metadata,
            )
        elif observation["kind"] == "gfx":
            roi = observation["ROI_xywh"]
            exposure = observation["display_exposure"]
            target = np.load(checked(observation["target"]), allow_pickle=False)
            noisy = pixels(noisy_malvar(arrays), arrays, roi, exposure)
            truth = pixels(target, arrays, [0, 0, 160, 160], exposure)
            metadata.update({"ROI_xywh": roi, "source_ROIs": observation["metadata"]["region"]})
            board(
                observation["id"] + "-comparison",
                [("Noisy Malvar", noisy)]
                + [(label, pixels(p, arrays, roi, exposure)) for label, p in predictions]
                + [("ISO100 ref (not GT)", truth)],
                metadata,
            )
            board(
                observation["id"] + "-triplet",
                [
                    ("Noisy Malvar", noisy),
                    (model_label, pixels(new, arrays, roi, exposure)),
                    ("ISO100 ref (not GT)", truth),
                ],
                metadata,
            )
        else:
            exposure = observation["display_exposure"]
            for case in observation["cases"]:
                roi = case["ROI_xywh"]
                noisy = pixels(arrays["noisy_rgb"], arrays, roi, exposure)
                truth = pixels(arrays["reference_rgb"], arrays, roi, exposure)
                metadata_case = {**metadata, "case": case, "ROI_xywh": roi}
                board(
                    observation["id"] + "-" + case["name"] + "-comparison",
                    [("Noisy Malvar", noisy)]
                    + [
                        (label.replace("-profile3879", ""), pixels(p, arrays, roi, exposure))
                        for label, p in predictions
                    ]
                    + [("ISO100 ref (not GT)", truth)],
                    metadata_case,
                )
                board(
                    observation["id"] + "-" + case["name"] + "-triplet",
                    [
                        ("Noisy Malvar", noisy),
                        (model_label, pixels(new, arrays, roi, exposure)),
                        ("ISO100 ref (not GT)", truth),
                    ],
                    metadata_case,
                )
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in metrics:
        groups[(row["case"], row["method"])].append(row)
    summaries = []
    for (case, method), values in groups.items():
        if len(values) != 4 or {v["pattern"] for v in values} != {"RGGB", "BGGR", "GRBG", "GBRG"}:
            raise ValueError("Require the same single draw across all four CFA patterns")
        bands = []
        for entry in values[0]["bands"]:
            matches = [next(b for b in v["bands"] if b["bin"] == entry["bin"]) for v in values]
            if len({b["blocks"] for b in matches}) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Reference-defined blocks changed between patterns")
            bands.append(
                {
                    "bin": entry["bin"],
                    "blocks": entry["blocks"],
                    **{
                        key: float(np.mean([b[key] for b in matches]))
                        for key in ("gain", "band_error_RMS", "orthogonal_residual_RMS")
                    },
                }
            )
        summaries.append(
            {
                "case": case,
                "method": method,
                "CFA_patterns": 4,
                "draws_per_CFA": 1,
                "reference_role": values[0]["reference_role"],
                **{
                    key: float(np.mean([v[key] for v in values]))
                    for key in ("camera_RGB_PSNR", "sRGB_PSNR")
                },
                "bands": bands,
            }
        )
    with (output / "metrics.csv").open("x", newline="") as stream:
        fields = [
            "case",
            "method",
            "pattern",
            "draw",
            "reference_role",
            "camera_RGB_PSNR",
            "sRGB_PSNR",
        ]
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows({k: r[k] for k in fields} for r in metrics)
    save(
        output / "report.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-and-scored-awaiting-native-review",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "collection": ref(collection_path),
            "reporter": ref(__file__),
            "model_label": model_label,
            "metrics": metrics,
            "summaries": summaries,
            "images": images,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "RAW_decodes": 0,
            "PNG_channels_verified": sum(len(i["panels"]) * 160 * 160 * 3 for i in images),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    print(json.dumps({"images": len(images), "rows": len(metrics), "summaries": summaries}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("collection", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--model-label")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report(args.plan, args.collection, model_label=args.model_label)

"""Attribute unchanged V67 inference costs on four retained GFX RAW contexts.

CUDA events measure inclusive branch intervals; the separate operator trace is
instrumented and is not an end-to-end or full-frame speed benchmark. CPU mode
exists only to verify real-model hooks, inputs and unchanged outputs beforehand.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import statistics
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

from demosaic.cfa import color_indices
from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.precision import amp_context
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def describe(value):
    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        return {
            "shape": list(value.shape),
            "dtype": str(value.dtype),
            "logical_bytes": value.numel() * value.element_size(),
            "contiguous": value.is_contiguous(),
            "channels_last": value.ndim == 4
            and value.is_contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last),
        }
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return [describe(v) for v in value]
    return None


def model_hash(model):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
        value = value.detach().cpu().contiguous()
        digest.update(name.encode() + str(value.dtype).encode() + str(tuple(value.shape)).encode())
        # Singleton dimensions can be "contiguous" yet retain a non-unit last
        # stride (notably channels-last 1x1 weights). Byte reinterpretation
        # requires unit stride. Copy the logical values to a canonical vector;
        # this also supports scalars and BF16 without converting their values.
        flat = value.reshape(-1).clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
        digest.update(flat.view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
    return digest.hexdigest()


@contextmanager
def instrument(model, device):
    modules = {
        "DINO-context-inclusive": model.context,
        "DINO-backbone-nested": model.context.backbone,
        "restoration-trunk": model.pretrained_rgb.network,
        "RAW-head-inclusive": model.pretrained_rgb.raw_kernel,
        "RAW-coefficients-nested": model.pretrained_rgb.raw_kernel.coefficients,
    }
    with instrument_modules(modules, device) as records:
        yield records


@contextmanager
def instrument_modules(modules, device):
    """Attach observational hooks; never return replacements or retain tensors."""
    assert modules and all(isinstance(module, torch.nn.Module) for module in modules.values())
    records, stacks, handles = {name: [] for name in modules}, {name: [] for name in modules}, []

    def begin(name):
        def hook(_module, args):
            region = torch.profiler.record_function("demosaic::" + name)
            region.__enter__()
            start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) if device.type == "cuda" else None
            if start is not None:
                start.record()
            stacks[name].append(
                {
                    "start_cpu": time.perf_counter(),
                    "start": start,
                    "region": region,
                    "inputs": describe(args),
                }
            )

        return hook

    def end(name):
        def hook(_module, _args, output):
            entry = stacks[name].pop()
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - entry["start_cpu"]) * 1000
            stop = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) if device.type == "cuda" else None
            if stop is not None:
                stop.record()
            entry["region"].__exit__(None, None, None)
            records[name].append(
                {
                    "CPU_interval_ms": elapsed,
                    "start": entry["start"],
                    "end": stop,
                    "inputs": entry["inputs"],
                    "output": describe(output),
                }
            )

        return hook

    try:
        for name, module in modules.items():
            handles.append(module.register_forward_pre_hook(begin(name)))
            handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(end(name), always_call=True))
        yield records
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
        assert all(not value for value in stacks.values())


def collect(records, cuda):
    result = {}
    for name, entries in records.items():
        assert entries
        result[name] = {
            "calls": len(entries),
            "CPU_interval_ms": [entry["CPU_interval_ms"] for entry in entries],
            "CUDA_interval_ms": [entry["start"].elapsed_time(entry["end"]) for entry in entries]
            if cuda
            else None,
            "inputs": entries[0]["inputs"],
            "output": entries[0]["output"],
        }
    return result


def load_inputs(report, device, batch_size, native_size):
    source = json.loads(report.read_text())
    records = [r for r in source["float_contexts"] if r["role"] == "noisy-packed"]
    assert len(records) == 4 and batch_size in (1, 4) and native_size in (256, 512)
    packed, provenance = [], []
    for record in records[:batch_size]:
        path = report.parent / record["image"]
        assert sha(path) == record["sha256"]
        value = np.load(path, allow_pickle=False)
        assert (
            value.shape == (1, 4, 256, 256)
            and value.dtype == np.float32
            and np.isfinite(value).all()
        )
        packed.append(torch.from_numpy(value[..., : native_size // 2, : native_size // 2].copy()))
        provenance.append(
            {
                **record,
                "path": str(path),
                "profile_context_xywh": [*record["context_xywh"][:2], native_size, native_size],
            }
        )
    raw = torch.cat(packed).to(device)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        raw = raw.contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    metadata = next(r["metadata"] for r in source["sources"] if r["role"] == "noisy")
    shot, read = source["conditioning"]["shot"], source["conditioning"]["read"]
    return [
        raw,
        raw.clamp_min(0) * shot + read,
        color_indices(metadata["pattern"], device=device)[None].expand(batch_size, -1),
        torch.tensor(metadata["white_balance"], device=device)[None].expand(batch_size, -1),
        torch.tensor(metadata["camera_to_srgb"], device=device)[None].expand(batch_size, -1, -1),
    ], {
        "report": str(report),
        "report_sha256": sha(report),
        "cases": provenance,
        "conditioning": source["conditioning"],
        "metadata": metadata,
    }


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(
    checkpoint,
    gfx_report,
    output,
    device="cuda",
    batch_size=4,
    native_size=512,
    warmup=3,
    samples=5,
):
    os.nice(5)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    device = torch.device(device)
    if device.type == "cpu":
        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized() and batch_size == 1 and native_size == 256
    else:
        assert batch_size == 4 and native_size == 512
    assert warmup >= 1 and samples >= 2
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    batch, provenance = load_inputs(gfx_report, device, batch_size, native_size)
    model, state = load_checkpoint(checkpoint, device)
    assert state["loaded_sha256"] == sha(checkpoint)
    assert model.config.raw_kernel_reconstruction and model.config.raw_kernel_phase_conditioning
    model.eval()
    if device.type == "cuda":
        model.to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    model.set_noise(provenance["conditioning"]["shot"], provenance["conditioning"]["read"])
    step, digest = state["step"], state["loaded_sha256"]
    del state
    before = model_hash(model)
    rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
    cuda_rng = torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone() if device.type == "cuda" else None

    def synchronize():
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)

    def forward():
        with amp_context(device, dtype="float16" if device.type == "cuda" else "float32"):
            return model(*batch)

    for _ in range(warmup):
        reference = forward()
    synchronize()
    assert (
        reference.shape == (batch_size, 3, native_size, native_size)
        and reference.dtype == torch.float32
    )
    assert torch.isfinite(reference).all()
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
    unhooked_ms = []
    for _ in range(samples):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        actual = forward()
        synchronize()
        unhooked_ms.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        assert torch.equal(actual, reference)
    with instrument(model, device) as records:
        for _ in range(samples):
            actual = forward()
            synchronize()
            assert torch.equal(actual, reference)
    branches = collect(records, device.type == "cuda")
    assert all(row["calls"] == samples for row in branches.values())
    activities = [torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU]
    if device.type == "cuda":
        activities.append(torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA)
    with (
        torch.profiler.profile(
            activities=activities, record_shapes=False, with_stack=False, profile_memory=True
        ) as profile,
        instrument(model, device) as trace_records,
    ):
        actual = forward()
        synchronize()
    assert torch.equal(actual, reference)
    trace_branches = collect(trace_records, device.type == "cuda")
    keys = profile.key_averages()
    operators = [
        {
            "name": row.key,
            "calls": row.count,
            "self_CPU_us": row.self_cpu_time_total,
            "inclusive_CPU_us": row.cpu_time_total,
            "self_device_us": row.self_device_time_total,
            "inclusive_device_us": row.device_time_total,
            "self_CPU_memory_bytes": row.self_cpu_memory_usage,
            "self_device_memory_bytes": row.self_device_memory_usage,
        }
        for row in keys
    ]
    assert {"demosaic::" + name for name in branches} <= {row["name"] for row in operators}
    cuda_events = sum(
        str(event.device_type) == "DeviceType.CUDA" and event.time_range.elapsed_us() > 0
        for event in profile.events()
    )
    if device.type == "cuda":
        assert cuda_events > 0, "No genuine CUDA events; profiler fallback is not GPU evidence"
    trace = output / "operator-trace.json"
    profile.export_chrome_trace(str(trace))
    assert model_hash(model) == before
    assert torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), rng)
    if cuda_rng is not None:
        assert torch.equal(torch.cuda.get_rng_state(), cuda_rng)
    assert sha(checkpoint) == digest
    np.save(output / "unchanged-reference-f32.npy", reference.cpu().numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
    archive = output / "source"
    archive.mkdir()
    sources = {str(path): sha(path) for path in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    for path in [Path(__file__), *map(Path, sources)]:
        (archive / path.name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    result = {
        "status": "completed-real-V67-CPU-profiler-preflight-no-GPU-timing"
        if device.type == "cpu"
        else "completed-real-V67-bounded-CUDA-inference-profile",
        "checkpoint": {"path": str(checkpoint), "sha256": digest, "step": step},
        "inputs": provenance,
        "device": str(device),
        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
        "hardware": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device)
        if device.type == "cuda"
        else "CPU engineering preflight",
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "native_size": native_size,
        "warmup": warmup,
        "samples": samples,
        "unhooked_forward_synchronized_ms": unhooked_ms,
        "unhooked_median_ms": statistics.median(unhooked_ms),
        "inclusive_branches": branches,
        "instrumented_trace_branches": trace_branches,
        "operator_statistics": sorted(
            operators,
            key=lambda row: row["self_device_us"] if device.type == "cuda" else row["self_CPU_us"],
            reverse=True,
        ),
        "genuine_CUDA_trace_events": cuda_events,
        "trace": {"path": str(trace), "sha256": sha(trace)},
        "all_hooked_unhooked_profiled_outputs_bitwise_reference": True,
        "model_and_actual_DINO_state_hash_before_after": before,
        "model_and_actual_DINO_state_unchanged": True,
        "CPU_and_CUDA_RNG_unchanged": True,
        "source_files": sources,
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "CUDA_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
        "peak_CUDA_allocation_GB": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) / 1e9
        if device.type == "cuda"
        else None,
        "scope": "Unchanged checkpoint and fixed input batch; no optimization, compile, weight/precision/tile change, quality score or promotion. Branch intervals are inclusive and nested; never sum parent and child times. Profiler statistics/trace are instrumented, separate from synchronized unhooked forward samples. Excludes RAW decoding, input transfer, output transfer, tiling/blending and encoding; not a100MP speed result or throughput sweep. Shared-machine measurements do not establish idle hardware performance. CPU mode verifies hooks and identity only, never GPU bottlenecks.",
        "API_sources": [
            "https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/profiler.html",
            "https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.cuda.Event.html",
        ],
    }
    (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {"result": str(output / "result.json"), "status": result["status"], "step": step}
        ),
        flush=True,
    )

def expected_training_model_config(parent_config, plan, arm):
    """Allow only the declared ADC training constraint; keep prior plans exact."""
    expected = copy.deepcopy(parent_config)
    overrides = plan.get("model_overrides", {})
    if overrides:
        if (
            plan["arms"] != ["V98", "V99"]
            or arm not in plan["arms"]
            or overrides != {"V99": {"adc_cfa_projection": True}}
            or overrides["V99"]["adc_cfa_projection"] is not True
            or expected.get("adc_cfa_projection", False)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported training model override")
        expected.update(overrides.get(arm, {}))
    return expected


def worker(plan_path, phase, arm):
    import torch
    import yaml
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    import demosaic.train as training
    from demosaic.model import ModelConfig

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    initial_model_sha = plan.get("initial_model_sha256", MODEL_SHA)
    parent_step = plan.get("parent_step", 2000)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / f"{phase}-{arm}.claim").open("x").close()
    config_path = plan["configs"][arm][phase]["path"]
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(config_path).read_text())
    assert resources(root, 32, **plan.get("disk_reserves", {}))
    if phase == "CPU":
        assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == "" and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    else:
        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
        quota = min(
            torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device),
            24 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory,
        )
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(quota, device)
    parent = torch.load(plan["parent"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    for key in ("validation_manifest", "raw_clean_manifest", "paired_manifest"):
        assert ref(config[key])["sha256"] == parent["config"][key + "_sha256"]
    expected = expected_training_model_config(
        ModelConfig.from_checkpoint(parent["model_config"]).to_dict(), plan, arm
    )
    assert json.dumps(ModelConfig(**config["model"]).to_dict(), sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(
        expected, sort_keys=True
    )
    constructor, batch_reader, writer = (
        training.JointDemosaic,
        training.prepare_training_batch,
        training.save_checkpoint,
    )
    optimizer_factory = training.make_optimizer
    capture, early = {}, []
    counts = {
        "training_forwards": 0,
        "validation_forwards": 0,
        "DINO_calls": 0,
        "optimizer_steps": 0,
    }

    def instrument(options):
        model = constructor(options)
        capture["model"] = model

        def before(module, args, kwargs):
            assert len(args) == 5 and set(kwargs) <= {"auxiliary"}
            assert not module.training or kwargs == {"auxiliary": True}
            assert args[0].shape[0] <= config["batch_size"]
            if counts["training_forwards"] == 0:
                capture["initial_model_sha256"] = model_hash(module)
                capture["DINO_sha256"] = model_hash(module.context.backbone)
                assert (
                    capture["initial_model_sha256"] == initial_model_sha
                    and capture["DINO_sha256"] == DINO_SHA
                )
                actual = module.restoration_state_dict()
                assert actual.keys() == parent["ema"].keys()
                assert all(torch.equal(v.cpu(), parent["ema"][k]) for k, v in actual.items())
                assert all(not p.requires_grad for p in module.context.backbone.parameters())
            counts["training_forwards" if module.training else "validation_forwards"] += 1

        def dino(*_):
            counts["DINO_calls"] += 1

        def after(module, args, value):
            if not plan.get("model_overrides"):
                return
            from demosaic.cfa import mosaic

            profiles = module.pretrained_rgb._noise_profiles
            profiles = profiles * len(args[0]) if len(profiles) == 1 else profiles
            selected = [i for i, (_, _, stochastic) in enumerate(profiles) if not stochastic]
            if module.training:
                capture["ADC_training_hook_images"] = capture.get(
                    "ADC_training_hook_images", 0
                ) + len(selected)
            if selected and module.config.adc_cfa_projection:
                with torch.no_grad():
                    prediction = value[0] if isinstance(value, tuple) else value
                    colors = args[2] if args[2].ndim == 1 else args[2][selected]
                    observed = args[0][selected]
                    sampled = mosaic(prediction[selected].float(), colors)
                    valid = (observed > 1 / 65535) & (observed < 1 - 1 / 65535)
                    error = (sampled - observed).abs()[valid]
                    maximum = float(error.max()) if error.numel() else 0.0
                    assert maximum <= 1e-6
                    capture["ADC_max_valid_sample_error"] = max(
                        capture.get("ADC_max_valid_sample_error", 0.0), maximum
                    )

        model.register_forward_pre_hook(before, with_kwargs=True)
        model.register_forward_hook(after)
        model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(dino)
        return model

    def observe(*args, **kwargs):
        batch = batch_reader(*args, **kwargs)
        if plan.get("model_overrides"):
            capture["training_images"] = capture.get("training_images", 0) + len(batch["packed"])
            capture["ADC_training_images"] = capture.get("ADC_training_images", 0) + int(
                ((batch["shot"] == 0) & (batch["read"] == 0)).sum()
            )
        if args[0] <= 24:
            early.append(
                {
                    "step": args[0],
                    "domain": args[1],
                    "batch_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(batch),
                }
            )
        return batch

    def retained(path, model, optimizer, ema, step, cfg, best):
        writer(path, model, optimizer, ema, step, cfg, best)
        if (
            (phase == "train" or plan.get("validation_preflight", False))
            and Path(path).name == "last.pt"
            and step in plan["retain_steps"]
        ):
            destination = Path(path).with_name(f"step-{step:06d}.pt")
            if destination.exists():
                # stop_after may save the same boundary again after validation.
                assert ref(path)["sha256"] == ref(destination)["sha256"]
            else:
                shutil.copyfile(path, destination)

    def optimizer(model, options):
        result = optimizer_factory(model, options)
        assert not result.state
        capture["fresh_optimizer_empty"] = True

        def after(*_):
            counts["optimizer_steps"] += 1

        result.register_step_post_hook(after)
        return result

    training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = instrument, observe
    training.save_checkpoint, training.make_optimizer = retained, optimizer
    updates = plan["planned_updates"] if phase == "train" else plan["proof_updates"]
    checkpoint = training.train(
        config_path,
        initialize=plan["parent"]["path"],
        stop_after=None if phase == "train" else updates,
    )
    model = capture.pop("model")
    assert model_hash(model.context.backbone) == DINO_SHA
    assert all(not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
    state = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    for key, value in config.items():
        if key != "validation_protocol":
            assert state["config"][key] == value, key
    assert state["step"] == counts["optimizer_steps"] == counts["training_forwards"] == updates
    if plan.get("model_overrides"):
        assert capture["training_images"] == updates * config["batch_size"]
        assert capture.get("ADC_training_hook_images", 0) == capture["ADC_training_images"]
        if phase != "CPU":
            assert 0 < capture["ADC_training_images"] < capture["training_images"]
    assert counts["DINO_calls"] == counts["training_forwards"] + counts["validation_forwards"]
    assert state["config"]["initialized_from"] == {**plan["parent"], "step": parent_step}
    assert json.dumps(
        ModelConfig.from_checkpoint(state["model_config"]).to_dict(), sort_keys=True
    ) == json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True)
    for section in ("model", "ema"):
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[section].values())
        assert any(not torch.equal(v, parent["ema"][k]) for k, v in state[section].items())
    for value in state["optimizer"]["state"].values():
        assert int(value["step"]) == updates
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in value.values() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor))
    for key in ("manifest", "validation_manifest", "raw_clean_manifest", "paired_manifest"):
        assert state["config"][key + "_sha256"] == ref(config[key])["sha256"]
    metrics_path = checkpoint.parent / "metrics.jsonl"
    metrics = [json.loads(line) for line in metrics_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    rows = [r for r in metrics if r["event"] == "train"]
    assert {r["domain"] for r in rows} == {"synthetic", "native-RAW-synthetic", "paired-RAW"}
    assert all(math.isfinite(r["loss"]) and math.isfinite(r["grad_norm"]) for r in rows)
    if phase != "train":
        assert len(rows) == updates
        if plan.get("validation_preflight", False):
            assert counts["validation_forwards"] == 120
            assert [r["step"] for r in metrics if r["event"] == "validation"] == [12, 24]
            assert all((checkpoint.parent / f"step-{n:06d}.pt").exists() for n in (12, 24))
        else:
            assert counts["validation_forwards"] == 0
    else:
        assert [r["step"] for r in rows] == [1, *range(25, updates + 1, 25)]
        assert [r["step"] for r in metrics if r["event"] == "validation"] == plan.get(
            "validation_steps", [4000, 8000, 12000, 16000, 20000]
        )
    if phase == "CPU":
        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-{arm}-result.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-V43-quality-stage-awaiting-independent-evaluation"
            if phase == "train"
            else "completed-discarded-V43-training-preflight",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "phase": phase,
            "arm": arm,
            "counts": counts,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "checkpoint": ref(checkpoint),
            "metrics": ref(metrics_path),
            **capture,
            "early_observations": early,
            "logged_training_observations": rows,
            "engineering_only": phase != "train",
            "CUDA_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
            "source_sha256": state["config"]["source_sha256"],
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )


def compare_pair(first, second, exact_domains, *, require_changes):
    audit = {"identical_shared_observations": 0, "changed_treatment_observations": 0}
    for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True):
        assert (a["step"], a["domain"]) == (b["step"], b["domain"])
        equal = a["batch_sha256"] == b["batch_sha256"]
        if a["domain"] in exact_domains:
            assert equal, (a["step"], a["domain"])
            audit["identical_shared_observations"] += 1
        else:
            audit["changed_treatment_observations"] += not equal
    assert audit["identical_shared_observations"] > 0
    if require_changes:
        assert audit["changed_treatment_observations"] > 0
    return audit


def controller(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child, identity = None, None

    def record(status, **extra):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **extra)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    def stop():
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            assert psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time() == identity["created"]
            assert os.getsid(child.pid) == child.pid
            import signal

            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=15)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                assert psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time() == identity["created"]
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait(timeout=10)

    try:
        curation = read(plan["curation"]["path"])
        if not plan["engineering_only"]:
            screen_ref = next(
                x
                for x in curation["inputs"]
                if Path(x["path"]).parent.name == "source-scores"
                and Path(x["path"]).name == "receipt.json"
            )
            assert ref(screen_ref["path"]) == screen_ref
            owner = read(screen_ref["path"])["owner"]
            record("waiting-for-original-corpus-screen-owner-exit", dependency=owner)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + plan["wait_seconds"]
            while live(owner):
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline
                time.sleep(2)
        for phase in plan["phases"]:
            for arm in plan["arms"]:
                guard(plan)
                record("waiting-for-stable-training-headroom", phase=phase, arm=arm)
                began, stable = time.monotonic(), None
                while True:
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["wait_seconds"]
                    stable = (
                        (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable)
                        if resources(root, 48, **plan.get("disk_reserves", {}))
                        else None
                    )
                    if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= plan["stable_seconds"]:
                        break
                    time.sleep(5)
                for directory in plan["cache_environment"].values():
                    Path(directory).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                env = dict(
                    os.environ,
                    PYTHONPATH=str(work / "src") + ":" + str(work / "scripts"),
                    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" if phase == "CPU" else "0",
                    HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"],
                    HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                    TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                    OMP_NUM_THREADS="2" if phase == "CPU" else "4",
                    OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="2",
                    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
                )
                env.update(plan["cache_environment"])
                with (root / f"{phase}-{arm}.log").open("xb") as log:
                    child = subprocess.Popen(
                        [
                            plan["python"],
                            "-P",
                            str(work / "scripts/train_v43_quality_trial.py"),
                            "worker",
                            str(plan_path),
                            "--phase",
                            phase,
                            "--arm",
                            arm,
                        ],
                        cwd=work,
                        env=env,
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=log,
                        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                        start_new_session=True,
                    )
                    identity = {
                        "pid": child.pid,
                        "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time(),
                    }
                    record("running-V43-quality-stage", phase=phase, arm=arm, child=identity)
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + plan["timeouts_seconds"][phase]
                    while child.poll() is None:
                        assert resources(root, **plan.get("disk_reserves", {})), (
                            "Training resource floor"
                        )
                        assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "Training stage runtime bound"
                        time.sleep(2)
                    assert child.wait() == 0, (phase, arm, child.returncode)
                path = root / f"{phase}-{arm}-result.json"

    child = child_owner = None
    try:
        for label, binding in queue["stages"].items():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            plan = read(binding["path"])
            guard(plan)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200
                save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "waiting-for-52GiB-headroom", "stage": label})
                time.sleep(2)
            assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30

            work = Path(plan["work"])
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
                       CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0", HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                       OMP_NUM_THREADS="1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                       CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8")
            with (root / f"collect-{label}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), "-P", plan["collector"]["path"], binding["path"]],
                    cwd=work, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,

                save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "running-declared-stage",
                                               "stage": label, "child": child_owner})

            result = work.parent / "collection-v1.json"
            assert read(result)["counts"] == {"root": len(plan["observations"]), "encoder": len(plan["observations"])}

    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)})
